copy:
Capricorn man
Aries woman

he plans the future.
she starts it.
role: public zodiac hook and premise lock
visual: Cozy balcony evening. Zuv sits with chai, a small notebook, and a phone calendar open, calmly planning tomorrow. Aachu is already standing with keys in hand, gently pulling him up by the wrist with an excited half-smile. His eyes move from the calendar to her hand; her body is angled toward the door. The balcony lights make the scene warm, lived-in, and playful.
cta_intent: make Capricorn/Aries couples tag each other because the planning-versus-starting contrast is instantly recognizable
